bagPolicy.summary: Soldier Field enforces the NFL Clear Bag Policy, allowing clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” and small non-clear bags up to 4.5” x 6.5”. All other bags are prohibited.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12” x 6” x 12”
Small non-clear bags up to 4.5” x 6.5”
prohibited: Any non-clear bag larger than 4.5” x 6.5”
bagPolicy.note: Medical bags are allowed and will be searched. Diapers must be in a clear bag. Each family member can carry an approved clear bag and a clutch purse.

parking.note: Soldier Field parking lots, prepaid requirements, traffic routes, and public-transit recommendations vary by event. Review the official parking and transportation page before arrival.

rideshare.note: Use the 18th Street drop-off west of Soldier Field and Lake Shore Drive. For the first hour after the event, rideshare pickup is at Balbo and Columbus. After one hour, pickup can resume on the stadium campus.

concessions.summary: Soldier Field is cashless. Alcohol is sold only at designated concession stands, and alcohol policies are posted at every stand.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: If Ticketmaster has exhausted its allocation of wheelchair-accessible seating, but conventional seating is still available, the disabled patron is invited to proceed with the purchase of conventional seating near their desired location and then reach out to the respective team (Chicago Bears at 847.295.6600 or Chicago Fire FC at 888-MLS-FIRE).

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Fans are not permitted to exit and re-enter the stadium. Gate 8 also serves as the exit and re-entry gate should a Service Animal need a relief area.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will call is at the large ticket booth across from Gate 10 at the southeast corner. Collect on event day with photo ID matching the name on the tickets.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Gate 8 also serves as the exit and re-entry gate should a Service Animal need a relief area.
